_comment: Pre-change assignment baseline for LAT-866, captured from Latitude V2 PRODUCTION ClickHouse. taxonomy_observations is retained 30 days, so these rows no longer exist after 2026-09-16 — this file is the only surviving record of what the 0.65 floor admitted. Reproduce the shape with scripts/taxonomy/snapshot-assignment-baseline.ts.
_floorDecision: 0.81 is the median cluster's own p10 and was the first candidate; the perProjectImpact block below ruled it out. The at-0.81 figures are kept as that evidence, not as the shipped calibration.

byAssignmentMethod._comment: gated = the paths this change adds a floor to. gardening_birth is NOT gated by it (build path, out of scope) yet is the largest population and bottoms lowest — the dominant unfloored hole after this PR.

perProjectImpact._comment: Over the 11 projects with >=50 assignments on a gated path, measured from stored assignment_confidence. The fleet number is a tail, not a level: the median project barely moves while the worst loses seven eighths of its assignments. See rootGateCorrection for why these understate the online path.

arms._comment: Exactly one project is on the full-window reassignment path, so change 2's blast radius today is 154 observations/week. Every other project is affected only by the online gate.

fullWindowRouting.note: the narrow-domain ads-analytics pilot, the only adaptive project

sampleOnly.note: every other project; gardening_birth + centroid_online only

rootGateCorrection._comment: Stored assignment_confidence is the similarity at the DEEPEST accepted node, but routeToDeepestClusterUseCase gates at depth 0 first (one root per project), so the figures above understate online rejections. Corrected by estimating root similarity as confidence * cosine(assigned cluster centroid, root centroid), with the per-cluster cosine read from Postgres. Validated against 47 true cosines computed from the real root centroid: mean error +0.0032, mean |error| 0.0145, 1 of 47 decisions flipped at the 0.75 boundary. The 0.65 control lands at 0.1%, which is the check that the method holds at all -- every centroid_online row cleared 0.65 when it was assigned.

byAssignedDepth._comment: Rejections concentrate at depth 0, where stored confidence IS the root similarity and no estimate is involved. Deep assignments are nearly untouched because reaching depth 3 already required clearing the root and every split_link_threshold on the way down, so they are self-selected for high root similarity.

limitations: 27 of 162 clusters holding online rows (5,836 of 15,665, ~37%) are no longer active and are excluded entirely -- gardening retires the tree every ~6h.

Centroid drift measured at up to +/-0.07 on vmw7k4ro1ecianfmyx7gww3f, so a per-row verdict near the boundary is unreliable; aggregate shares stay roughly unbiased because the error is near-symmetric (mean +0.003).
